overview: Hollowshade Cliffside Watch is the Vah Shir’s primary observation post overlooking the Hollowshade warfront.
history: The watch was built to monitor Owlbear, Sonic Wolf, and Grimling movements.
Signal horns were added to warn Shar Vahl of warfront surges.
Archery platforms were reinforced during early tribal raids.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, lookout captains increased patrol rotations.
Emergency shelters were constructed for wounded scouts.
hooks: A signal horn fails during a tribal surge.
A cliffside platform destabilizes after a skirmish.
A lookout captain requests assistance with a scouting mission.
A wounded scout arrives with urgent intelligence.
